COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows significant hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and lymphopenia, with elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin), high INR, and mild metabolic acidosis (low CO₂). There is also mild monocytosis, eosinophilia, and basophilia. These findings suggest a systemic inflammatory response, possible coagulopathy, and impaired oxygenation, which may be seen in severe infection, sepsis, or inflammatory states. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
